summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.58/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.58 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 12¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ lower than a month ago, and 68¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.37) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.79).
